name: dahlia-ai
description: Self-hostable authenticated Responses gateway for Dahlia

scripts.build: pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:library-client
scripts.build:cloudflare: pnpm run ensure:wrangler && WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false vite build --config vite.cloudflare.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:package && pnpm run worker:dry-run
scripts.db:migrate:d1:local: pnpm run ensure:wrangler && WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler d1 migrations apply dahlia_db_prod --local
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:cloudflare: pnpm run ensure:wrangler && WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false vite dev --config vite.cloudflare.config.ts
scripts.start:databricks: pnpm run db:migrate:prod && pnpm run start
scripts.preview:cloudflare: pnpm run ensure:wrangler && WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false vite preview --config vite.cloudflare.config.ts
scripts.worker:dry-run: pnpm run build:cloudflare && WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker
scripts.worker:types: pnpm run ensure:wrangler && WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts
